vulnerabilities.title: Interface Definitions Only - No Implementation Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: This file contains only Rust trait definitions for the CW721 NFT standard. It defines function signatures for execute operations (transfer, send, approve, revoke, approve_all, revoke_all, burn) and query operations (nft_info, owner_of, approvals, tokens, etc.) but contains no implementation logic. The traits themselves are correctly defined with appropriate type constraints (Serialize + DeserializeOwned + Clone for token type T, CustomMsg for C). No vulnerabilities can be identified in pure interface definitions.
